title: Sustainable Agriculture Practices Explained Briefly
reason: The video discusses various practices and criteria for making farms and ranches more sustainable.

tasks.task: Explain the criteria for sustainable farming.

subtasks.text: Describe that sustainable farming practices should be productive, profitable, and enhance natural resources.
Mention that sustainable practices also improve quality of life for families and communities.

tasks.task: Describe how sustainable farmers work with nature.

subtasks.text: Note the focus on biodiversity, soil health, ecological pest management, and water conservation.
Highlight the use of practices like crop rotation, cover crops, and rotational grazing.

tasks.task: Explain the profitability aspect of sustainable farming.

subtasks.text: Describe that sustainable practices improve efficiency with resources.
Mention efforts to lower use of tillage and chemical inputs.
